name: Enterprise Sustainability Activity and Disclosure Binding
constraints: WM-ECO-034 owns disclosure revisions and cites external boundaries and calculation results.
WM-FLW-015 owns consumption quantities while WM-MAT-008 owns other measured observations.
Missing data remains unknown and financial spend never becomes a physical impact measurement.
Disclosure publication never changes evidence quality or calculation truth.
Every activity datum carries exactly one qualityClass from the closed set ["measured","estimated","modelled","allocated","spendProxy"].

acquisitionMethod refines qualityClass and never substitutes for it; derived and metered are acquisition facts, not quality classes; allowed values are ["metered","sensor","invoice","manual","derived"].
A new Activity Data root is forbidden; the profile allocates no identifier.
Exactly one activity-datum carrier exists per source, interval and quantity kind; consumption uses WM-FLW-015 and cites WM-MAT-008 observations as evidence.

A spendProxy activity datum carries proxyBasis with monetaryAmount, currency, currencyYear, deflatorRef and eeioFactorVersionRef; proxyBasis is never read as a physical quantity and never as an impact quantity.

WM-ECO-034 owns only the disclosure-side approval, assurance, filing, publication and compliance states; assurance engagement identity, scope, level and conclusion are externally mastered, unallocated, and out of contour.
holds: WM-ECO-034 overlap and assurance mastership require reconciliation.
Independent Grok review and frozen audit remain pending.
GWP characterization set, market-instrument retirement and assurance engagement remain unallocated out-of-contour dependencies.
No approved relation edge exists for any reference in this profile.
